# Halberd Kill Chain — IDEF0 model set

The Halberd verbs drawn as IDEF0 plates: one model per top-level step of DefendAgainstThreat, so each step
can be owned by one team. Every box is a function from `model/`; a box is decomposed
on its own plate when the function is composed of smaller functions (2 to 9 per plate).

- **Inputs** (left): the data a function transforms, named after the flow wired into it.
- **Controls** (top): orders, authorizations and rules (the `control_types` of `sysml.conf`),
  plus policy constants (parameters with default values, such as thresholds).
- **Output** (right): the one result the function returns.
- **Mechanism** (bottom): the part (noun) that performs the function, from the model's
  `allocate` statements; a function without its own allocation inherits its parent's.
- **Model line** (`t`): the step's own inputs, controls and output (its A-0 context). Hand-offs
  between steps are cross-model links (`<` comes from, `>` goes to), listed in `INTERFACES`.

## Model D — Detect

Turn sensor returns into declared detections, looking where the sensors are tasked.

SPINE: D1 Condition Signals.

Team: Detect. Performed by: Sensor Segment.

Interfaces: takes Sensor Returns; Sensor Tasking. Hands on Detection Set to T Track.

```idef0
tD Detect
## Turn sensor returns into declared detections, looking where the sensors are tasked.
  i# Sensor Returns
  c# Sensor Tasking
  o# Detection Set
  m# Sensor Segment
  a# Condition Signals
    ## Filter and calibrate raw returns.
    i# Sensor Returns
    o# Conditioned Signals
    m# Surveillance Radar
  a# Declare Detections
    ## Declare detections where the sensors are tasked.
    i# Conditioned Signals
    c# Sensor Tasking
    o# Detection Set > T|Associate Detections|Detection Set
    m# Sensor Segment
```

## Model T — Track

Associate detections with tracks and keep every track up to date.

SPINE: T1 Associate Detections.

Team: Track. Performed by: Fire Control Software.

Interfaces: takes Detection Set (from D). Hands on Track Set to E Engage, I Identify.

```idef0
tT Track
## Associate detections with tracks and keep every track up to date.
  i# Detection Set
  o# Track Set
  m# Fire Control Software
  a# Associate Detections
    ## Pair each detection with a track, or start a new one.
    i# Detection Set < D|Declare Detections|Detection Set
    o# Associations
    m# Fire Control Software
  a# Maintain Tracks
    ## Update, start and drop tracks.
    i# Associations
    o# Track Set > I|Characterize Tracks|Track Set
    m# Fire Control Software
```

## Model I — Identify

Decide what each track is, against the threat library.

SPINE: I1 Characterize Tracks.

Team: Identify. Performed by: Fire Control Software.

Interfaces: takes Track Set (from T); Threat Library. Hands on Classified Track Set to C Decide.

```idef0
tI Identify
## Decide what each track is, against the threat library.
  i# Track Set
  c# Threat Library
  o# Classified Track Set
  m# Fire Control Software
  a# Characterize Tracks
    ## Collect what is observed about each track.
    i# Track Set < T|Maintain Tracks|Track Set
    o# Track Features
    m# Fire Control Software
  a# Classify Threats
    ## Match track features against the threat library.
    i# Track Features
    c# Threat Library
    o# Classified Track Set > C|Evaluate Threats|Classified Track Set
    m# Fire Control Software
```

## Model C — Decide

Rank the threats, pair interceptors with them, and schedule authorized launches.

SPINE: C1 Evaluate Threats.

Team: Decide. Performed by: Engagement Control Station.

Interfaces: takes Classified Track Set (from I); Engagement Doctrine; Fire Authorization. Hands on Engagement Plan to A Assess, E Engage.

```idef0
tC Decide
## Rank the threats, pair interceptors with them, and schedule authorized launches.
  i# Classified Track Set
  c# Engagement Doctrine
  c# Fire Authorization
  o# Engagement Plan
  m# Engagement Control Station
  a# Evaluate Threats
    ## Order the threats under the doctrine.
    i# Classified Track Set < I|Classify Threats|Classified Track Set
    c# Engagement Doctrine
    o# Threat Priorities
    m# Engagement Control Station
  a# Pair Weapons
    ## Assign available interceptors to the ranked threats.
    i# Threat Priorities
    o# Weapon Pairings
    m# Engagement Control Station
  a# Schedule Engagements
    ## Schedule launches, only once fire is authorized.
    i# Weapon Pairings
    c# Fire Authorization
    o# Engagement Plan > E|Launch Interceptor|Engagement Plan
    m# Engagement Control Station
```

## Model E — Engage

Launch the scheduled interceptors and guide them to their threats.

SPINE: E2 Guide Interceptor -> E21 Uplink Track Updates.

Team: Engage. Performed by: Interceptor Segment.

Interfaces: takes Engagement Plan (from C); Track Set (from T). Hands on Engagement Events to A Assess.

```idef0
tE Engage
## Launch the scheduled interceptors and guide them to their threats.
  i# Engagement Plan
  i# Track Set
  o# Engagement Events
  m# Interceptor Segment
  a# Launch Interceptor
    ## Launch the interceptor the plan calls for.
    i# Engagement Plan < C|Schedule Engagements|Engagement Plan
    o# Launch Event
    m# Launch Segment
  a# Guide Interceptor
    ## Keep the interceptor on course with track updates until it homes on its own.
    i# Launch Event
    i# Track Set < T|Maintain Tracks|Track Set
    o# Engagement Events > A|Judge Engagement|Engagement Events
    m# Interceptor Segment
    a# Uplink Track Updates
      ## Send track updates to the interceptor in flight.
      i# Launch Event
      i# Track Set
      o# Inflight Updates
      m# Interceptor Segment
    a# Home On Target
      ## The interceptor's own terminal homing.
      i# Inflight Updates
      o# Engagement Events
      m# Interceptor Segment
```

## Model A — Assess

Judge each engagement and record it.

SPINE: A1 Judge Engagement.

Team: Assess. Performed by: Fire Control Segment.

Interfaces: takes Engagement Events (from E); Engagement Plan (from C). Hands on Engagement Record.

```idef0
tA Assess
## Judge each engagement and record it.
  i# Engagement Events
  i# Engagement Plan
  o# Engagement Record
  m# Fire Control Segment
  a# Judge Engagement
    ## Decide whether the threat was defeated.
    i# Engagement Events < E|Guide Interceptor|Engagement Events
    o# Kill Assessment
    m# Fire Control Segment
  a# Report Outcome
    ## Record the engagement and report it.
    i# Kill Assessment
    i# Engagement Plan < C|Schedule Engagements|Engagement Plan
    o# Engagement Record
    m# Fire Control Segment
```
